props.name: expandable
props.description:
Allow click/keyboard to toggle collapsed ↔ expanded.
Defaults to `true` (Activity is expandable by design). Pass `false` to lock size.

props.name: expandAfter
props.description:
Auto-expand after this many milliseconds (uncontrolled, or fires `onExpandedChange`).
Useful for “compress then grow” live-activity timing.

props.name: hideCollapsedContent
props.description:
When true, collapsed state is an empty pill (no icon/title/body).
Content is revealed only after expand.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading visual — any icon, emoji, SVG, or image node.

props.name: mode
props.description: Compact pill, detail panel, or always-on persistent strip.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100; renders a meter when status is `progress` (or whenever value is provided).

examples.title: Collapsed summary
examples.code:
import { Activity } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Activity
  title="Uploading"
  description="Project.zip"
  status="progress"
  progress={68}
>Example</Activity>

examples.title: Expand on click
examples.code:
import { Activity } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Activity
  title="Uploading"
  description="Project.zip"
  status="progress"
  progress={80}
  minHeight="9rem"
>Example</Activity>

examples.title: Hidden content until expand
examples.code:
import { Activity } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Activity
  hideCollapsedContent
  title="Uploading"
  description="Project.zip"
  status="progress"
  progress={80}
  width={360}
  minHeight="9rem"
  height="9rem"
>Example</Activity>

examples.title: Custom expanded size
examples.code:
import { Activity } from '@larose-ui/react';

<Activity
  title="Syncing"
  description="Library photos"
  status="progress"
  progress={55}
  icon="↻"
  hideCollapsedContent
  expandAfter={900}
  width="28rem"
  minHeight="12rem"
  height="12rem"
>Example</Activity>
